correctness.rationale: The exterior square of the standard S_n module has character chi=((X1-1)(X1-2))/2-X2. The central projection convolution has norm d_n E|chi|=2d_n E[(X2-a_X1)_+], and counting permutations with j fixed points, k 2-cycles and a residual permutation avoiding 1/2 cycles yields the displayed rational finite sum. The EGF e^(-z-z^2/2)/(1-z) and entire weighted positive-part series imply faster-than-R^-n convergence for each fixed R>1. Independent full permutation enumerations for n=4..8 gave exact norms 9/4,3,20/3,10,4249/320, consistent with the universal argument.
